subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub keep the fixed MIT-0 skill-license contract for published skills, or approve declared MIT support for skills whose package/LICENSE metadata says MIT?
rationale: Current main and docs intentionally encode a platform-wide MIT-0/no-attribution contract, while the reporter's package metadata and the linked PR point toward preserving declared MIT; automation cannot choose that legal/product contract.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Keep the platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation rather than mixed stored licenses.

options.title: Approve declared MIT support
options.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2964 and require consistent schema, API, CLI, UI, docs, migration/backfill, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Leave this issue and the linked PR open until maintainers decide the license contract and obligations for already-published versions.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
recommendation.body: Keep the platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation rather than mixed stored licenses.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the MIT-0 enforcement path and posted the prior product-direction comment choosing fixed MIT-0 licensing.
